reasons: The gap is correctly identified: Section 10's 'renewable one-year term' supplies no renewal mechanics, notice window, reminder, or pricing cap, so a 'missing' finding is appropriate.

The inserted subsection matches the preferred position precisely — successive twelve-month renewals, a 30-day Customer opt-out, a 60-day Vendor renewal/pricing reminder, and uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3% — and is drafted as an addition without stripping anything favourable to us.

The failed deterministic check ('non-renewal notice window ≤ 60 days — number not found') is a regex/phrasing artefact; the clause plainly states 'at least thirty (30) calendar days', which satisfies both the preferred (≤30) and fallback (≤60) thresholds.
Comment is accurate, correctly attributes the reminder obligation to Garman and the opt-out to Sparkling, cites the playbook position, and offers the 5%/60-day fallback in the required tone.

Minor, non-blocking: the new subsection is appended after an exclusions-list item ('(5) ...') and is labelled '(d)', so confirm the lettering and placement align with the existing Section 10 structure when the redline is applied.
